استسررت (form X)
# اِسْتَسْرَرْتُ (istasrartu) /is.tas.rar.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَسَرَّ (istasarra)
# اِسْتَسْرَرْتَ (istasrarta) /is.tas.rar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَسَرَّ (istasarra)
# اِسْتَسْرَرْتِ (istasrarti) /is.tas.rar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَسَرَّ (istasarra)
# اُسْتُسْرِرْتُ (ustusrirtu) /us.tus.
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
